The right tip of the cucumber slice appears to merge indistinctly with the background/plate edge, lacking a clean termination point. The geometry feels slightly soft and undefined compared to the sharp left edge.

To analyze the realism of the moist flesh texture and the seasoning distribution.
To verify the boundary integrity between the cucumber, the seasoning, and the plate, checking for bleeding edges.
